summary: This Form 8-K reports the closing of an asset-backed securitization (ABS) transaction by CarMax Auto Funding LLC and CarMax Select Receivables Trust 2026-B. On June 16, 2026, the depositor entered into trust agreements, a receivables purchase agreement, a sale and servicing agreement, and a contribution agreement to transfer motor vehicle retail installment sale contracts to the issuing entity and grantor trust. No terms (size, yield, spread) are disclosed. This is a routine ABS issuance — the registrant is the depositor, notifying of the completion of a structured financing. There are no special-situation elements; it is simply a standard securitization closing.
